visual_review.method: Viewed final 1440x1080 desktop, 390px full-page mobile and populated desktop reader-detail PNGs after the final 29-check run.
observations: The sidebar, header, editable question, settings and list/right-reader workspace remain familiar; the preview has no hero-page replacement.
Cool shell surfaces, a subtle warm reader, restrained blue outlines and colored modality icons establish clearer separation without adding decorative content.
The original question, four modality tiles and two initial source points remain readable. Visible provider-observation counts and source actions align on the card action row.

At 390px, question text, focus chips, card titles and action controls wrap within the viewport. The concept control retains a visible icon. No overlap or clipping was observed in the captured initial view.
visual_review.qualification: This is a dense app refinement for comparison. Metadata and chips are deliberately compact; these captures and representative contrast checks are not a complete accessibility audit or approval for production adoption.

limitations: Static authored design preview. Local UI demonstrations do not prove production API, provider/model, persistence or account behavior.
Contrast checks cover representative opaque text/background pairs; gradient/translucent backgrounds are unmeasured and this is not a complete WCAG or screen-reader audit.
Earlier previews are visited read-only for authored-content comparison; their sources, reports and captures are not changed.
